goal: Establish CGKN Codex Edition as the separately named Codex-and-tools branch distribution with a dedicated launcher and runtime identity while preserving the CGKN kernel and formal Provider delivery route.
acceptance_criteria: Edition runtime and supervisor state use generated/cgkn_editions/codex and .cgkn/editions/codex.
README, edition documentation, kernel documentation, registry, and runtime baseline use the edition identity consistently.
Static checks, kernel guards, supervisor tests, and documentation consistency checks pass.
The branch distribution is named CGKN Codex Edition while formal schemas and kernel identity remain CGKN.
The active Codex task is the sole conversation entry and no project-specific conversation launcher is required.

quality_metrics.measure: management artifacts conform to registered JSON schemas and semantic invariants
quality_metrics.target: all management, iteration, and experience artifacts validate
quality_metrics.method: jsonschema tests plus deterministic manager validation

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: bounded Codex escalation usefulness and authority isolation
quality_metrics.target: a librarian-curated request and Codex response stay within configured budgets, preserve request identity, produce actionable guidance, and cannot assert formal evidence or delivery authority
quality_metrics.method: schema validation, deterministic contract tests, support-pipeline prompt tests, and an offline failed-generation replay

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: The branch name resolves exactly to codex/cgkn-codex-edition.
README.md and EDITION.md present CGKN Codex Edition as the distribution name and preserve CGKN as the formal kernel namespace.
The active Codex task attaches to CGKN supervision with API generation and edition-specific state paths.
Project-specific conversation launchers are absent so operators see one Codex conversation surface.
The kernel guard binds the Codex-only interface and rejects a reintroduced detached conversation path.

feedback: CGKN Codex Edition now has a dedicated branch identity, canonical launcher, isolated runtime paths, and consistent operator documentation without changing the formal CGKN Provider delivery mainline.

worked: Treating the name as a branch distribution label preserved the formal CGKN kernel and schema contracts while giving the Codex toolset a clear product identity.
did_not_work: The prior Codex-supervised profile label described a mode but did not identify a separately maintained distribution or branch.
experiments: After the existing working tree is reviewed and committed, publish the branch and run one private-chat supervisor smoke from the edition launcher.
